Lemma
[linear images and invariant ODE cones] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0118 ↗ def:chow-ii-conjugated-curvature-quadratic 1. ch11:11.26\group Invariant Curvature Cones Let $C\subset \mathcal A_n$ be a closed convex $O(n)$-invariant cone. Then $\ell _{a,b}(C)$ is preserved by $\dot R=Q(R)$ if and only if $C$ is preserved by $\dot R=X_{a,b}(R)$.
Proof

\sketch A curve $R(t)$ solves $\dot R=Q(R)$ precisely when $\ell _{a,b}^{-1}R(t)$ solves $\dot S=X_{a,b}(S)$. Since $R(t)\in \ell _{a,b}(C)$ is equivalent to $\ell _{a,b}^{-1}R(t)\in C$, invariance of either set is equivalent to invariance of the other.

□
